def.brief: Correct and verify the self-management environment in hunsu.json, then 'hunsu lock' from this Claude session. (1) roles.coherence and reporters hunsu/chongdae/mangsang: '--target {target}' becomes '--target .'. The released chongdae and dwitbuk resolve_argv expand only {plugin:NAME} (plus {since} for reporters and {base} for coherence) and run with cwd=project, so the literal '{target}' reached the commands: the hunsu and chongdae reporters failed, and coherence and the mangsang reporter read a nonexistent path as an empty net. Reporter {since} stays. (2) Worker roles become explicit released argv with --host, the owner's delegated routine role choice. Models stay host defaults (no --model/--effort). implementer: hacheong worker.py --member dakdol --host codex. newbie: --member chojja --host codex. nitpick: --member teujip --host claude. quibble: --member sibi --host claude. verifier: dwitbuk eyes_worker.py --host claude. reviewer unchanged: [python3, {plugin:dwitbuk}/dwitbuk.py, review, --target, .]. No capability alternate names a host. (3) Kept and acknowledged: the lock stays a Claude lock (host claude-code). Released hunsu 1.15.1's fingerprint counts Codex's .codex-marketplace-install.json, so the Codex view of check fails for hunsu, mangsang and jokbo. That is Codex parent drift (a hunsu defect fixed separately), not hidden: no metadata removed, no --take-content, no Codex-host lock, and no claim that the Codex host environment passes. Checks: hunsu check (Claude view) exits 0; the lock's reporters all answer dwitbuk/findings@1 through dwitbuk's released collect; the lock's coherence argv has no {target} and exits 0 through chongdae's resolve_argv; the worker hosts are as assigned, no {target} is left in roles or reporters, and every worker argv resolves (--prompt-only exits 0).
